Protocol Questions

faq

Clear answers to your key questions

Understand the market mechanics before taking a position

What exactly am I trading?

Synthetic perpetual exposure to an equity’s price. You do not own shares, receive dividends, or acquire shareholder rights.

How does FloatSheets price thin stocks?

FloatSheets combines at least three licensed data sources in an attested enclave. A signed midpoint and confidence band determine execution eligibility and risk parameters.

What happens when the underlying halts?

The market mirrors the underlying halt. Normal opens and closes are blocked; any deleveraging follows published rules. Resumption requires repricing under the gap protocol.

How much leverage is available?

Leverage ranges from 2 to 10× according to market liquidity and risk tier. Wide confidence bands and after-hours conditions reduce leverage. Markets pause execution when price quality or market state falls outside the permitted limits.

How are positions settled?

Positions use USDG collateral. Realized gains, losses, and applicable fees settle against the liquidity vault, while the dashboard keeps position exposure and available collateral in view.

How does the loss waterfall work?

The insurance fund absorbs gap losses first, followed by junior insurance capital. LP principal is exposed only in a declared default. These layers absorb losses but cannot eliminate market risk.

Understand the market mechanics before taking a position

What exactly am I trading?

Synthetic perpetual exposure to an equity’s price. You do not own shares, receive dividends, or acquire shareholder rights.

How does FloatSheets price thin stocks?

FloatSheets combines at least three licensed data sources in an attested enclave. A signed midpoint and confidence band determine execution eligibility and risk parameters.

What happens when the underlying halts?

The market mirrors the underlying halt. Normal opens and closes are blocked; any deleveraging follows published rules. Resumption requires repricing under the gap protocol.

How much leverage is available?

Leverage ranges from 2 to 10× according to market liquidity and risk tier. Wide confidence bands and after-hours conditions reduce leverage. Markets pause execution when price quality or market state falls outside the permitted limits.

How are positions settled?

Positions use USDG collateral. Realized gains, losses, and applicable fees settle against the liquidity vault, while the dashboard keeps position exposure and available collateral in view.

How does the loss waterfall work?

The insurance fund absorbs gap losses first, followed by junior insurance capital. LP principal is exposed only in a declared default. These layers absorb losses but cannot eliminate market risk.
